sentences.text: Mira, 8, began a Hill's z/d trial on Jun 1 and ate part of 4 meals before the owner stopped it on day 19 of 42.
She was more interested in her usual Purina ONE, which stayed available.
Vomiting was logged 4 times in the first 16 days and once in the last 16, on 5 of 19 logged days.
Her weight moved from 4.4 to 4.1 kg; this can be reviewed at the next visit.
